algorithm.genomic_guard: Merge each collection/chromosome old closed interval expanded by10000bp; test closed intersection with each new half-open interval endpoints, reproducing inclusive gap<=10000 convention.
algorithm.group_ID: SHA256 of newline-joined lexicographically sorted variant IDs without trailingnewline
algorithm.grouping: Exact source parent; floor(start/1Mb) bin keyed by chromosome; separate strict-positive-interval overlap; any 200nt allele/either strand Hamming<=20. Complete new-new components precede old-exposure exclusion.
algorithm.new_new_index: 21 disjoint pieces, sorted flat C++ index, forward stored alleles and both query strands; verify every cross-component candidate by seven-word packed Hamming. Skip only already-connected components.
algorithm.old_explicit: 21 pieces for <=20 mismatches; every retained allele and both strands screened.
algorithm.old_factorized: 22 pieces for <=21 reference mismatches, exact allowed observed-SNV repair at21; <=20 reference matches directly.
algorithm.pruning: Whole already-exposed components need no further old-hit enumeration. Old coordinates never union new components, and old nodes never receive1Mb bins.
